plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator

**See the current DeepSeek API pricing window at a glance in the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web GUI.**

A single 5px dot sits in the composer tool row, **just left of the model name** (**rendered only when the
session's selected model provider is DeepSeek**):

| Color | Window | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🟡 Yellow `#f2b705` | Peak hours | Standard |
| 🟢 Green `#22c55e` | Off-peak hours | Half price |

Nothing else is rendered — no text, no icon, no placeholder copy (the dot carries an
`aria-label` for screen readers). No build step, no third-party dependencies: the whole
plugin is one file.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

## When it shows

The dot renders only while the session's selected model provider is DeepSeek; otherwise it
renders nothing at all and takes no space:

| Provider | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `deepseek-official` (DeepSeek API key) | ✅ |
| `deepseek-account` (DeepSeek account) | ✅ |
| Anything else (Anthropic, an OpenAI-compatible gateway, a self-hosted proxy, …) | ❌ hidden |
| Unknown (model directory still loading) | ❌ hidden |

The provider is what counts, not the model name — a third-party gateway serving a DeepSeek
model does not get DeepSeek's time-of-day pricing. The rule lives in `isDeepSeekProvider()`;
change that one function to change the policy.

The session's model directory is resolved **after mount, with retries**: a freshly switched
session has not registered its scope yet, so the lookup legitimately fails for a moment. The
dot therefore appears a fraction of a second after a session switch instead of staying hidden
for the whole session.

## How the window is decided

Per DeepSeek's official pricing page
([Models & Pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing)):

- **Peak**: Beijing time **Monday–Friday** (excluding Chinese statutory holidays),
  **09:00–12:00** and **14:00–18:00**;
- **Off-peak**: everything else, **including weekends and statutory holidays all day**
  (off-peak = half of the peak price).

Intervals are half-open: 12:00 and 18:00 sharp already count as off-peak, while 09:00 and
14:00 sharp count as peak. All comparisons use `Asia/Shanghai`, so the machine's own time
zone does not matter.

> **Make-up workdays.** The official wording is "Monday to Friday … all other periods,
> including weekends and Chinese statutory holidays, are off-peak all day". A Saturday or
> Sunday that the government designates as a make-up workday therefore stays off-peak
> (green) here. Change the `WORKDAYS` check in `client.js` if you disagree.

## Installation

Requires a working DSH profile (desktop app or `dsh web`).

The recommended way is to **paste a GitHub address into the Plugins page** — no clone and no
commands:

1. Open the **Plugins** page from the sidebar (the plugin icon in the panel list).
2. Click **Add plugin**.
3. Paste this address into the field (it accepts a package name, a GitHub repository address,
   or a local directory path):

   ```
   https://github.com/cumthugo/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator
   ```

   The shorthand `github:cumthugo/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator` works too; add a branch or
   commit to pin a revision, e.g.
   `github:cumthugo/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator#<commit-sha>`.

4. It is live as soon as it finishes: the result reads `application: applied` and the open
   page needs no refresh. If it reports `restart-required`, restart Harness.

The installer writes the package into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` and dependencies,
and inserts the loader row declared by this repository's own `cordis.patch.yml` — you never
edit a config file by hand.

### Installing through the agent (equivalent)

```
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=github:cumthugo/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator
```

Before installing, the manager runs a `git ls-remote` reachability check against the
repository (public repos need no credentials).

### Installing from a local directory (when editing the code)

1. Clone the repository:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/cumthugo/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator.git
   ```

2. Paste the **absolute path** of the clone into the same field (or hand it to the agent):

   ```
   plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=/absolute/path/to/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator
   ```

   The profile records a `link:` dependency, so re-installing after an edit is enough.

**Update**: re-installing the **same source** does **not** take effect — the dependency is
unchanged, so the installer reports `ambiguous-install`. Uninstall on the Plugins page first,
then add the same address again:

```
plugin_manager  action=remove_bundle  target=dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle target=github:cumthugo/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator
```

The host re-reads the bundle and pushes it to the open page, so no restart is needed. (The
local-directory flavour works the same way — swap the second target for the clone path;
switching to a different source, e.g. from a local path to the GitHub address, also avoids
the ambiguity.)
**Disable / uninstall**: toggle the row on the GUI Plugins page, or use `plugin_manager`'s
`remove_bundle` with the package name `dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator`.

> The package name matches the repository (`dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator`) and is not
> published to npm — install it by local path or from GitHub as shown above. The name must
> match the `id` in `client.js`'s `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` and the entry `name`
> in `cordis.patch.yml`: change one and all three must change, followed by a reinstall.

## Holiday data and automatic refresh

Holidays are only used to exclude statutory days off from the peak windows. Three sources,
in priority order:

1. **Local cache** — `localStorage` key `dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator:holidays:<year>`, considered
   fresh for 30 days;
2. **Network refresh** — the year JSON from
   [holiday-cn](https://github.com/NateScarlet/holiday-cn) (which scrapes the State Council
   holiday notices), trying `raw.githubusercontent.com` then `cdn.jsdelivr.net`, with a 6 s
   timeout;
3. **Built-in fallback** — `BUILTIN_HOLIDAYS` in `client.js` (currently 2026, 33 days off).

So **next year's schedule takes effect automatically once published**, with no code change,
provided the machine can reach one of those two hosts. Fully offline, the built-in table is
used; for a year with neither cache nor built-in data the plugin degrades to a
weekend-only rule (that year's holidays would be misread as peak during 09:00–12:00 and
14:00–18:00).

To refresh the built-in table offline:

```bash
node tools/update-holidays.mjs            # existing years + this year and the next
node tools/update-holidays.mjs 2027       # only the given years
```

Run the remove → install flow above afterwards, so the page picks up the new built-in table.

## Layout

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Bundle manifest: `dsh.bundle.patch` and the `dsh.client` declaration |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `deepseek-offpeak-indicator` loader row |
| `index.js` | Host half, empty `apply()` (it exists so the loader has a host row) |
| `client.js` | Browser half: window logic, the dot component, slot registration (one file, no build) |
| `tools/update-holidays.mjs` | Regenerates the built-in holiday table |
| `tools/test-classify.mjs` | Regression tests: peak windows, the provider gate, and the session-switch resolve/retry path (31 assertions) |

## Customizing

Everything lives at the top of `client.js`: `PEAK_WINDOWS`, `PEAK_COLOR` /
`OFFPEAK_COLOR`, `DOT_SIZE` (default `5`), `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_IDS` /
`isDeepSeekProvider()` (which providers count as DeepSeek), plus the slot and its placement —
the dot registers into `conversation.input.right`, which renders immediately left of the model
name, and `nudgeX` / `nudgeY` shift it by a few pixels (currently `16` / `1`). To move it
elsewhere change `name` in `ctx.slots.register` (e.g. `conversation.input.left`,
`conversation.composer.dock`) and adjust `id` accordingly.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: ask_user_question popup enhancement - selecting an option reveals a per-option note input, sent to the model with the selection
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-question-note

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-question-note.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-question-note)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-question-note.svg)](LICENSE)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）「交互式问答」弹窗增强插件：**用户点选某个选项后，在该选项正下方出现一个可选的补充说明输入框；填写的内容与选中的选项一并传给模型。**

## 效果

- 原版弹窗的样式、功能、交互全部保留（组件是官方 `QuestionComposer` 的忠实移植，同一套 CSS 令牌与几何）。
- **补充说明按选项独立存储**：每个被选中的选项下方各有一个自己的补充输入框，互不共享、不随勾选变化移动；取消勾选时输入框隐藏，文字保留（重新勾选会恢复）。单选题换选选项时同理，各选项各记各的。
- 提交时答案格式不变：`{ "answers": [ { "id": "...", "selected": ["选项文字"], "custom": "…" } ] }`。`custom` 的组装规则：单选 = 补充文本原文；多选 = 每个有补充的选项一行、格式「选项文字: 补充」（模型可分清哪句对应哪个选项）；底部自由回答行若有内容追加在最后。不填补充说明时行为与原版完全一致。
- 底部「其他（自定义输入）」行保留，是独立的自由回答入口（单选打字清空已选 = 原版语义；多选与勾选并存 = 原版语义）。
- 计划审查（plan-review）类卡片、审批卡片、超时后续答、已结算回答回看等全部由官方组件处理，本插件不接管。

## 与原版的唯一行为差异

启用后，**单选点选项不再自动跳到下一题**（原版会跳，但那会让用户没机会填写补充说明），而是停留在当前题并展开输入框；在输入框里回车或点「下一题」按钮进入下一题，最后一题回车即提交。

## 实现原理（面向二次开发者）

- 纯客户端 Cordis 插件：浏览器半往 `conversation.composer` 链式槽以 `priority: -10`（官方在默认 0）注册增强版组件，链选举「数值小者先跑、第一个 select 非 null 者胜出」，因此增强版先被询问并接管通用问题卡的渲染；官方插件的卡片注册、倒计时、投影、续答机制原样复用（`src/client/carrier.ts` 以结构化方式消费官方载体对象）。
- 鸭子类型失配时 `select` 返回 null → 安全降级为官方弹窗（功能缺失但弹窗可用）。
- 合并方案零协议改动：宿主端 `userQuestions.answer()` 只校验「每题恰好回答一次」，不禁止 `selected` 与 `custom` 并存；工具结果与超时续答消息都是原样 JSON 透传。

## 开发与安装

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build     # 产出 lib/index.js（宿主半）与 lib/client.js（浏览器半）
pnpm run check     # 产物语法检查

# 安装到 desktop 配置（会写入 dsh.profile.bundles，需重启 DSH 生效）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本目录路径或 npm 包名>
```

## 版本兼容

针对 DSH 0.2.0-rc 族（`@deepseek-ai/*` peer `^0.2.0-rc.1`）。官方弹窗组件内部结构若在后续版本变化，需同步调整 `src/client/carrier.ts` 的结构匹配与 `src/client/composer.tsx` 的移植。

plugins.description: 腾讯 WorkBuddy 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 插件：浏览器 OAuth 登录、无需 API Key。Tencent WorkBuddy LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin for **Tencent WorkBuddy**.

Sign in through your browser — **no API key required** — and use WorkBuddy's own model list.

## Features

- **Browser OAuth sign-in** — authorize in a normal browser tab; no API key needed, ever. Sign in to either the China or the international site.
- **Full model catalog** — WorkBuddy's own models, with context windows, output caps, and credit multipliers; server-side additions and removals are picked up automatically.
- **Streaming chat** — responses stream in real time.
- **Tool calls** — function calling, with a clear error when a model does not support it.
- **Reasoning effort** — pick a thinking level for models that support one.
- **Image input** — attach images for vision-capable models (models without vision support may be routed to a different model by the server).
- **Usage indicator** — a quota bar in the Web UI sidebar for both personal and enterprise plans, with an optional custom cap and a configurable danger threshold.

## Compatibility

| Requirement | Version |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) | `>= 0.1.7-rc.1` |

Web UI features such as the settings page, model picker, and usage indicator require the `web` profile.

## Install

Add the plugin to a dsh profile — the `web` profile backs the Web UI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wenh56884-wq/dsh-llm-workbuddy
```

The repository ships its compiled `lib/`, so a Git install needs no build step and no
dev dependencies. Installing from a source checkout works too:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-llm-workbuddy
```

## Sign in

Open **Settings → WorkBuddy** in the Web UI and pick a site: **Sign in (China)** for [www.workbuddy.cn](https://www.workbuddy.cn) or **Sign in (Intl)** for [www.workbuddy.ai](https://www.workbuddy.ai). The browser login opens in a new tab; the harness writes the credential automatically. No terminal needed.

The two sites are the same service on different hosts but hold **separate accounts** — one site's account does not work on the other — so the site is chosen per sign-in and recorded with the credential. Every later request goes to the host that issued it. To move to the other site, sign out and sign in again.

Alternatively, sign in from the terminal:

```bash
# A CLI fallback; the Web UI sign-in above is recommended.

# Sign in to the China site (the default; equivalent to --site cn)
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login

# Sign in to the international site
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --site intl

# Show the signed-in account, its site, and the model list
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --status

# Remove the stored credential
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --logout
```

Once signed in, WorkBuddy's models appear in the model picker.

## Build

From a source checkout:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build
```

This compiles the host half with `tsc` and bundles the Web client half with `esbuild`, both into `lib/`.

## Provenance and license

MIT. This plugin is a WorkBuddy adaptation of
[`@shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy`](https://github.com/shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy)
(MIT, © 2026 Shatyuka), which is the original work it derives from: the host
architecture, the browser-OAuth handshake, the model-catalog reader, the
settings page, and the usage indicator are all its author's design. This
repository re-points that client at the WorkBuddy deployments — the site list,
the product token every request identifies itself as, and the provider,
settings, and credential identifiers are WorkBuddy's — and renames it
accordingly. The upstream copyright notice is retained in
[`LICENSE`](./LICENSE) as the license requires.

When the upstream project releases fixes, they can be diffed in against this
tree: the changes here are confined to the identifiers, the two service roots
in `src/constants.ts`, and the catalogue User-Agent documented there.

plugins.description: Turn LLM responses into live interactive mini-apps, calculators, and themed Mermaid diagrams inside DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# 🪄 Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness English | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [中文](README.zh.md) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-Plugin-emerald.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) > **Turn LLM responses into live, interactive mini-apps directly inside DeepSeek Harness.** **Intelligent UI** is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (Desktop & Web UI) inspired by ChatGPT's Intelligent UI and Claude Artifacts. Instead of generating static walls of text, the model writes markdown embedded with interactive component tags, reactive expressions, and beautiful Mermaid diagrams. The chat interface renders them in-place in real time as the response streams in. --- ## 📸 Screenshots | 🧮 Interactive Cost Simulator | ⚖️ Interactive Tech Stack Comparison | | :---: | :---: | | | |

🎨 Themed Mermaid Diagrams with Rounded Nodes & Semantic Role Colors

--- ## ✨ Key Features - ⚡ **Real-Time Interactive Mini-Apps**: Sliders, number inputs, dropdowns, and toggles recompute formulas, statistics, and charts instantly inside your browser—no backend round-trips needed. - 📊 **Rich UI Component Library**: Over 20 built-in components including KPI tiles (`stat`), bar/line/pie charts (`chart`), responsive layouts (`box`, `row`, `grid`), progress bars, data tables, badges, and segmented controls. - 🎨 **Beautiful Themed Diagrams**: Automatically transforms ` ```mermaid ` fences into styled diagrams with rounded cards, dark/light theme harmony, and hierarchy-aware typography. - 🔁 **Bidirectional Interaction**: Action buttons (`GenUI.issueNewTurn(...)`) let you send configured values back to the agent as your next prompt with a single click. - 🧠 **Context-Aware Triggering**: The model intelligently uses UI only when helpful (e.g., calculations, comparisons, workflows) and answers simple questions in clean plain text. - 🔒 **Secure by Design**: Expressions execute inside a sandboxed AST interpreter without `eval`, DOM access, or network permissions. Form state stays strictly within your local browser session. --- ## 🚀 Installation Requires **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** or later (Desktop app or `dsh web`). ### Option 1: Web UI / Desktop App (Easiest) 1. Open DeepSeek Harness. 2. Navigate to **Plugins** → Click **Add plugin**. 3. Enter either package name or repository URL: ``` @rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui ``` or ``` https://github.com/rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui ``` 4. Click **Install**. The plugin is ready to use immediately without restarting! ### Option 2: CLI Installation Run the following command in your terminal: ```sh # For Desktop app profile (make sure to quit Desktop first): dsh plugin --profile desktop add @rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui # For Web server profile: dsh plugin --profile web add @rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui ``` > **Note**: To temporarily return to plain-text replies, simply toggle off the plugin in **Plugins**. --- ## 💡 Example Prompts to Try Once installed, prompt the model naturally with questions that benefit from interactivity: - **Simulators & Estimations**: > *"Create a SaaS pricing simulator where I can adjust team seats and billing frequency (monthly vs. annual) and see the discount impact."* - **Product Comparisons**: > *"Compare MacBook Pro M3, ThinkPad X1 Carbon, and Dell XPS 13 for battery life, weight, price, and developer workflows with interactive filters."* - **Workflow & Architecture Diagrams**: > *"Draw a flowchart showing how a GitHub pull request goes through CI checks, code review, and deployment."* - **Financial & Planning Calculators**: > *"Build a mortgage repayment calculator with loan amount, interest rate slider, and amortization chart."* --- ## 🛠️ How It Works (What the Model Writes) The plugin injects concise instructions into the system prompt. The model writes standard Markdown enhanced with JSX-like component tags and reactive state declarations: ```md {@body const [seats, setSeats] = useState(25)} {@body const [price, setPrice] = useState(1200)} Team Plan Estimator ``` ### Supported Components & Syntax | Category | Available Elements | |---|---| | **Layout & Structure** | ``, ``, ``, ``, `` | | **Typography & Data** | ``, `<text>`, `<caption>`, `<label>`, `<badge>`, `<icon>`, `<stat>`, `<progress>` | | **Tables & Collections**| `<table>`, `<table-row>`, `<table-cell>` | | **Data Visualization** | `<chart type="bar|line|pie|area" data={...}/>`, Themed Mermaid diagrams | | **Interactive Controls**| `<slider>`, `<input>`, `<checkbox>`, `<radio-group>`, `<radio>`, `<segmented-control>`, `<select>`, `<button>` | | **Expressions & Logic** | `{expression}`, `{#if condition}...{/if}`, `{#each item in list}...{/each}`, `{@body ...}` | --- ## 🛡️ Security & Privacy - **Sandboxed Execution**: Expressions are evaluated via a safe AST interpreter. There is no `eval()`, `new Function()`, access to `window`/`document`, or network fetch access. - **Local State Privacy**: Interactive input state is saved per message in your browser's local storage. Values are never sent to the model until you explicitly click an action button. - **Safe Resources**: External links open via DeepSeek Harness's native safe URL handler. External images only load from model-specified HTTPS URLs. --- ## 📋 Compatibility - **DeepSeek Harness**: `v0.2.0-rc.1` or later - **Tested Models**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet / 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4o / GPT-6.1, DeepSeek-V3 / R1 --- ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). Distributed client bundles package [mermaid](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid) and [zod](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod). See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for full licensing disclosures.

plugins.description: DSH 技能管理器：自带基础技能与中文工程流程技能包，按「你遇到的问题」分组展示，模型可在对话里直接读写；升级技能包不覆盖你改过的文件。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-starter

**装完就有 6 个能直接用的技能，外加一个 20 个技能的工程流程包。** 设置页里能看能改，AI 也能在对话里直接读写技能库。

| 装完立刻得到 | 是什么 |
|---|---|
| **6 个基础技能** | `ask-first` 需求没说清时先问完再动手、`prove-it` 改之前先说清怎么验证、`write-my-skill` 一句话把你的做法记成技能 |
| **20 个工程流程技能** | 从拷问需求 → 收规格 → 拆票 → 实现 → 双轴审查 → 复盘，一整套；外加诊断 bug、TDD、原型、研究、教学 |
| **按症状分组的面板** | 按「你遇到的问题」分组，不用记技能名；能编辑、新建、复制内置技能 |
| **一张「我该用哪个」对照表** | 29 行处境对照，点一行跳到对应技能 |
| **AI 在对话里直接读写** | 你说「把这套流程记下来」，它直接落盘，不会写错格式 |

> **升级技能包不会覆盖你改过的文件。** 装进来之后那份归你——插件只加新技能、修错字，不碰你动过的任何一行。

技能（skill）是 DSH 里最实用的东西：把一套做法写成一个文件，之后随时调用，AI 每次都按同一套流程做事。麻烦的地方在于管——文件散在几个目录、frontmatter 写法要记、装了一堆想不起用哪个、改过的还怕被升级冲掉。

**这个插件把这几件事一起解决了。**

---

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-skill-starter
```

`desktop` 换成你自己的 profile 名（`~/.dsh/profiles/` 下面的目录名）。装完重启 `dsh`。

包在 npm 上：<https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-skill-starter>。

验证：设置页里出现「**Skill 管理**」这一项，或者直接问 AI「我有哪些技能」。

### 装不下来时改用源码包

网络或镜像有问题时，改用 GitHub 上的固定 tag 地址：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/ymck-x/dsh-skill-starter/archive/refs/tags/v0.3.0.tar.gz
```

> **请照抄这个完整地址，不要改成 `refs/heads/main.tar.gz`。**
> 分支地址的内容会随作者推代码而改变，而 pnpm 会记下你安装当时的指纹。
> 之后你装**任何**插件时，pnpm 都会重新核对全部旧依赖，一旦发现指纹对不上就中止整次安装
> （`ERR_PNPM_TARBALL_INTEGRITY`），而且报错指向一个你当时根本没在装的包。
> `refs/tags/` 指向一次固定发布，内容永不改变——代价是**换版本时要手改上面那个 tag 号**。

也不要写成 `github:ymck-x/dsh-skill-starter` 这种简写：它会被 pnpm 解析成 SSH 地址（`git+ssh://`），而匿名 SSH 访问 GitHub 会被直接拒绝，装不上。

### 没有 dsh 命令时手动装

`dsh plugin add` 内部就是「pnpm 装包 + 把包名写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`」。你也可以自己做这两步：

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add dsh-skill-starter
```

从 npm 装不下来时，把 `dsh-skill-starter` 换成上面那个 GitHub tag 地址。

再把 `dsh-skill-starter` 加进同一个目录里 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "dsh-skill-starter"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

重启 `dsh` 即生效。

### 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-skill-starter
```

手动装的：从 `bundles` 里删掉这一项，再 `pnpm remove dsh-skill-starter`。

**卸载不影响你写的技能**——它们在 `~\.dsh\skills\` 里，不属于插件。

---

## 它做什么

### 一、设置页里的面板

打开「设置 → Skill 管理」，你看到的是**按你遇到的问题分的组**，不是按名字排的字母序：

```
开工之前
  先把票据和规格放在哪定下来。
  setup-tickets

别让它做错方向
  动手之前，把没问清的问完。
  ask-first

看不懂就拉回来
  说「没看懂」时，用大白话重讲上一段。
  plain-words

别让「改好了」是空话
  先说清用什么办法验证，改完真的跑一遍再报告。
  prove-it
  一次只走一小步，每步验证过再继续。
  tiny-steps

让它记住你的做法
  一句话把你的做法记成技能文件。
  write-my-skill
```

选一条就能改：名称、描述、使用时机、正文，还有两个调用开关。也能新建、删除、把内置技能复制一份出来改。中英双语，跟着界面语言走。

### 二、「我该用哪个」

面板里有一块处境对照表，直接显示路由技能里那张表——现在 29 行，点一行就跳到对应的技能。

这张表**不是复制过来的**：插件每次从 `skills-map/SKILL.md` 现读现解析，所以它和路由技能永远是同一份内容，不会两边说法不一致。

### 三、技能包

技能包是「一组相关技能，一次装完」。自带一个：

| 包 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `engineering-zh` | 20 个中文工程流程技能：拷问需求 → 收成规格 → 拆票 → 实现 → 双轴审查 → 复盘，外加诊断 bug、TDD、原型、研究、教学、交接 |

**升级不覆盖你的修改**，三层保护：

| 情况 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 你改过这个文件 | 跳过，并在结果里点名 |
| 文件已存在且内容不同 | **绝不覆盖**，单独列出 |
| 内容相同 | 只登记指纹，不动文件 |

所以想改包里的技能，直接改用户目录里那份就行，不用担心下次升级被冲掉。

### 四、模型能直接用

插件注册六个工具，AI 在对话里就能读写技能库、装卸技能包，不用你打开设置页：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `skill_list` | 列出全部技能：来源、调用方式、是否被覆盖、附件数 |
| `skill_read` | 读出完整内容与附件清单 |
| `skill_write` | 新建或修改 |
| `skill_delete` | 删除 |
| `skill_pack_list` | 技能包状态 |
| `skill_pack_install` | 安装或升级，不覆盖你的改动 |

所以你说「把这套流程记下来」，它会直接落盘，不会写错格式。

---

## 为什么这么设计

### 问题一：技能写完了没人用

技能要生效，得有人知道它什么时候该上场。三种做法叠起来解决：

- **描述里写用户的原话**。`tdd` 的描述是「说『写个测试再实现』『先红后绿』时使用」——AI 靠这句判断该不该自己调用。
- **面板按症状分组**。用户先看到症状（「别让『改好了』是空话」），再看到药。
- **只给人用的技能明确标出来**。会改变工作状态的动作（收规格、拆票、交接、复盘）只允许你手动发起，AI 不能自己决定。

### 问题二：装了一堆，不知道什么时候用哪个

二十多个技能，靠记名字不现实。所以有一张按**处境**写的对照表：

| 你现在的处境 | 加载哪个技能 |
|---|---|
| 有个想法，要把它问清楚 | `grilling` |
| 需求没说清，要先把该问的一次问完 | `ask-first` |
| 要在一个项目里建好票据约定 | `setup-tickets` |
| 要把已经聊清楚的结论写成规格 | `to-spec` |
| 要把规格拆成多张票据 | `to-tickets` |
| 做完了，不知道改动有没有问题 | `code-review` |
| 没坏，但比以前慢很多 | `diagnosing-bugs` |
| 这段代码改一次要动好几个地方 | `improve-codebase-architecture` |
| 不确定这个模块该怎么切 | `codebase-design` |
| 同一个词团队里有两个意思 | `domain-modeling` |
| 答案在别人脑子里 | `to-questionnaire` |
| 没听懂上一条 | `wait-what` |

完整 29 行在面板里，也在 `skills-map` 技能里。

### 问题三：技能越多，每轮对话越贵

技能的描述是**常驻**的——不管用不用，它都在每轮请求里占位置。所以插件把这个成本算清楚并公布：

| 部分 | 规模 | 估算 |
|---|---|---|
| 插件自带 6 个技能 | 448 字 | 约 269 到 538 token |
| 技能包 20 个技能（装了才有） | 1776 字 | 约 1066 到 2131 token |
| 六个工具的 schema | 671 字 | 约 403 到 805 token |
| **设置面板** | — | **0**（只在浏览器里跑） |
| **合计（装了技能包）** | 2895 字 | **约 1737 到 3474 token** |

不想要工具那部分开销，可以在配置里关掉：

```yaml
- id: dsh-skill-starter
  config:
    enableTools: false
```

关掉之后模型侧开销归零，设置面板照常。「我该用哪个」那块表也照常——它走面板自己的接口，不进模型上下文。

自己量一遍：

```sh
node measure.mjs
```

### 问题四：升级把改动覆盖了

上面那三层保护就是答案。设计上是这么想的：**技能包给的是起点，不是终点**。装进来之后那份文件归你，插件只负责以后添新技能、修错别字，不碰你动过的任何一行。

---

## 技能清单

技能分两类，区别在**谁能调用**：

- **模型可调用**：任务合适时 AI 会自己用；你也能打 `/名字` 手动调。
- **只允许人工发起**：只有你打出 `/名字` 才生效。它们会改变工作状态，不该由 AI 自己决定什么时候做。

### 插件自带（6 个基础技能）

| 技能 | 什么时候用 |
|---|---|
| `ask-first` | 用户提出还没说清的需求（「加个导出功能」） |
| `plain-words` | 用户说「没看懂」「说人话」 |
| `prove-it` | 任何改动开始前，先说清怎么验证 |
| `tiny-steps` | 改动涉及多个文件，或用户说「一步步来」 |
| `write-my-skill` | 用户说「把这条记下来」「以后都这样做」 |
| `setup-tickets` | 要给一个项目建票据约定 |

### 技能包 `engineering-zh`（20 个）

**只允许人工发起（9 个）**

| 技能 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `to-spec` | 把已经聊定的结论收成一份规格 |
| `to-tickets` | 拆成一组能各自收工的票据 |
| `implement` | 按票据逐张做出来 |
| `retro` | 回看这段会话，改进工作环境 |
| `handoff` | 压成交接文档，换人换机器接着干 |
| `to-questionnaire` | 答案在别人手里时，写一份问卷去问 |
| `wait-what` | 没听懂上一条，用大白话重讲 |
| `teach` | 跨多次会话学一门东西 |
| `improve-codebase-architecture` | 扫出结构改进机会，给候选让你挑 |

**模型可调用（11 个）**

| 技能 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `grilling` | 把还没想清的想法问到没有含糊 |
| `skills-map` | 路由表：从处境查到该用哪个 |
| `tdd` | 测试先行的红-绿循环 |
| `diagnosing-bugs` | 疑难 bug 的诊断纪律 |
| `code-review` | 双轴审查：规范轴 + 规格轴 |
| `codebase-design` | 深模块的词汇与判断标准 |
| `domain-modeling` | 维护项目术语表与架构决策记录 |
| `pr` | 拉取请求正文的三段结构 |
| `prototype` | 写一次性代码回答设计问题 |
| `research` | 查一手来源，留一份带引用的笔记 |
| `writing-for-agents` | 写给模型读的文档时的规范 |

技能包里的正文保持一屏内；词汇表、判断标准、例证这类细节放在同目录的附件里，正文末尾有一行指针。`tdd` 带 `MOCKING.md`，`code-review` 带 `SMELLS.md`，`codebase-design` 带 `DEEP-MODULES.md`，一共 10 份附件。

---

## 技能的三种来源

| 来源 | 位置 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 项目级 | `<项目>\.dsh\skills\`、`<项目>\.agents\skills\` | 跟着仓库走，DSH 原生扫描 |
| 用户级 | `~\.dsh\skills\` | 面板和工具都管这里 |
| 内置 | 插件自带的 `skills\` | 只读；在用户目录放一份同名的就能覆盖 |

**同名时优先级：项目级 > 用户级 > 内置。** 项目根按「最近的含 `.git` 的目录」判定，所以在子目录里也能找到。

面板只列用户级和内置（浏览器端拿不到会话的工作目录）；项目级技能在对话里问 AI 就能看到。

---

## 和同类插件的关系

DSH 生态里已经有两个做技能的插件，侧重和我们不同：

| 插件 | 侧重 |
|---|---|
| `dsh-skills` | 把散落各处（Claude Code、项目目录、`.skill` 包）的技能**汇总入库**，引用或副本两种方式，能导出打包 |
| `asakumizy/dsh-local-skills` | 本地技能浏览器，Notion 风格的界面 |
| **本插件** | **技能内容本身 + 分发**：自带一整套能用的技能，用技能包分发，管升级与本地改动 |

三个装在一起不冲突（id 不同），只是功能有重叠。**同一个技能名不要装两份**，那样每个技能会被注册两次。

---

## 开发

```sh
node verify.mjs        # 自测 59 项：解析、增删改查、路径安全、工具定义、技能包、项目级扫描、路由表
node check-tools.mjs   # 用 DSH 自己的 JSON Schema 校验器检查六个工具的定义
node check-pack.mjs    # 检查技能包内容是否符合规范
node measure.mjs       # 量出每轮对话的固定开销
```

**技能文件**（`skills/*/SKILL.md`）改动会热生效，保存即用。

**插件代码**（`index.js`、`client.js`）改动需要重载：`client.js` 刷新页面即可；`index.js` 因为 Node 会缓存已加载的模块，要把插件卸掉再装（或重启 DSH）。

要往包里加技能、或者重写技能时，先读 [`REWRITE-GUIDE.md`](REWRITE-GUIDE.md)：那里记了附件该怎么分类（模板类压进正文，方法类与机制类必须留附件），以及第一次重写时因为「一律单文件」而丢掉 19% 内容的教训。

要发版时，先读 [`RELEASING.md`](RELEASING.md)：npm 现在只认勾了 `Bypass 2FA` 的令牌，那份文档写着令牌怎么建、`.npmrc` 怎么写、发布后必须收回什么，以及 `403` 和 `404` 各自真正代表什么（`404` 不是包名问题，是认证无效）。那份文档整份复制到别的项目也能用。

### 目录结构

```
dsh-skill-starter/
  package.json           插件清单（dsh.bundle.patch 指向下面的补丁）
  cordis.patch.yml       告诉 DSH 加载这个插件
  index.js               宿主侧：注册内置技能、六个工具，提供面板接口
  client.js              浏览器侧：设置页「Skill 管理」面板
  skills/                6 个基础技能
  packs/engineering-zh/  技能包：20 个技能 + 10 份附件
  verify.mjs             自测
  check-tools.mjs        工具定义校验
  check-pack.mjs         技能包规范校验
  measure.mjs            成本测量
  REWRITE-GUIDE.md       重写或新增技能的规范
  RELEASING.md           发版到 npm 的流程（可整份复制到别的项目）
  CHANGELOG.md           更新记录
```

---

plugins.description: Relabels DSH's normalized WebP request images as image/png so local OpenAI-compatible vision servers (LM Studio, llama.cpp) accept them.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-webp-relabel

Relabels DSH's normalized WebP request images as PNG, so local OpenAI-compatible
vision servers accept them.

English | [简体中文](#简体中文)

## The problem

You paste a screenshot into DeepSeek Harness, pick a local vision model, and the
request dies with:

```
'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.
```

The image is fine. The **label** is not.

## Why it happens

DSH normalizes attachments before storing them, and `dsh-attachment-local` picks
the container from the alpha channel:

```js
const mediaType = hasAlpha ? "image/webp" : "image/jpeg";
```

Screenshots have an alpha channel, so they are stored as WebP. The request-image
ladder only ever emits `alpha:webp` or `opaque:jpeg` — there is no PNG rung and no
configuration option for this.

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` then builds the OpenAI `image_url` payload straight from the
prepared request image:

```js
mimeType: version.mediaType,               // "image/webp"
data: Buffer.from(version.data).toString("base64"),
```

so the wire payload becomes `data:image/webp;base64,...`. LM Studio / llama.cpp
validate that label against a PNG/JPEG allowlist and reject the whole call —
even though the bytes decode perfectly well.

## How it works

Wrap `attachments.readImageRequest()` and return **the same bytes** under a
compatible label:

```js
return { ...version, mediaType: 'image/png' };
```

Measured against LM Studio with `test/diagnostics/relabel-vs-transcode.py`:

| Payload | Result |
|---------|--------|
| webp bytes + `image/webp` | **HTTP 400** `'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.` |
| webp bytes + `image/png`  | **HTTP 200**, image correctly understood |
| png bytes + `image/png`   | HTTP 200 |
| png bytes + `image/webp`  | **HTTP 400** |

Only the label is validated, so no image transcoding is needed.
`test/diagnostics/vision-read.py` confirms the model really sees the image:
it reads a word drawn into a WebP image sent as `image/png`.

Three implementation details matter, and each was verified rather than assumed:

- **Why not rewrite the request messages?** The adapter takes the label from
  `readImageRequest(...).mediaType`, not from the message's
  `ImageBlock.attachment.mediaType`. Rewriting messages changes nothing.
- **Why is a service patch picked up immediately?** The adapter resolves the
  service per call (`resolveAttachments: () => ctx.get("attachments")`), so
  wrapping the method affects the very next request — no restart, no new session.
- **Why the prototype instead of the instance?** `ctx.get()` returns a Cordis
  "traceable" `Proxy` whose `set` trap routes through an extra shadow receiver, so
  an instance-level write is not reliably observable. A property on the prototype
  is always found by the proxy's own descriptor walk.

The model-visible attachment handle text is unaffected: it is built from
`ref.mediaType`, not `version.mediaType`, so it still describes the stored WebP
accurately.

## Install

### From a release tarball (no registry needed)

Download `dsh-webp-relabel-1.0.0.tgz` from the repository's Releases page, then:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /path/to/dsh-webp-relabel-1.0.0.tgz
```

### From npm

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-webp-relabel
```

### From a local checkout (verified)

Point the plugin manager at the directory:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-webp-relabel
```

The package is then registered as a link dependency, and its own
`cordis.patch.yml` supplies the loader row — so installing the bundle is the only
step. (Observed on DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`: `install_bundle` does **not** insert a row
by itself, which is why this bundle ships its own.)

Installing entirely by hand instead? Add the row to your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webp-relabel
      name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
```

## Configuration

The bundle already applies these defaults; add this block to your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` only to override them:

```yaml
- id: dsh-webp-relabel
  name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
  config:
    from: image/webp     # label to replace (default)
    to: image/png        # replacement label (default)
    debug: true          # log one line per relabeled image (default)
```

## Verify it works

With `debug: true` the DSH console prints one line per relabeled image:

```
[dsh-webp-relabel] relabel #1: image/webp -> image/png (1200x800px, 84521B, ref sha256:...)
```

You can also check the model server's own request log: the payload should contain
`"url": "data:image/png;base64,..."` rather than `image/webp`.

## Disable / uninstall

Disable the plugin in the DSH plugin manager, or set `to: image/webp` in the
config. Either way the original `readImageRequest` is restored from the saved
descriptor — the patch is fully reversible.

## Limitations

- **The label does not match the container.** The bytes stay WebP while the label
  says PNG. This is correct for servers that validate the label (LM Studio,
  llama.cpp). A provider that strictly validates magic bytes would still reject
  it, and the right fix there is real transcoding (`sharp`, `sips`) rather than
  relabeling.
- **It applies to every provider,** because `readImageRequest()` cannot see which
  route the call is going to. Scoping it to local routes would need an extra
  `llm/stream` listener keyed by `options.provider`.
- **It depends on DSH internals:** the `attachments` service, its
  `readImageRequest` method, and that method being a class method on the
  prototype. If a DSH upgrade breaks it, those are the two things to check.

## Development

```sh
npm test
```

Seven cases in `test/plugin-patch.test.mjs`, covering the relabel itself, that the
patch survives a Cordis-style traceable `Proxy`, that non-WebP labels pass
through untouched, that disposing restores the original method (including when it
is inherited from a base class), configurable targets, and idempotent re-apply.

`test/diagnostics/` holds the server-side probes described above.

---

## 简体中文

把 DSH 归一化出来的 WebP 请求图片**重标记为 PNG**，让本地 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型愿意收下它。

### 问题

在聊天窗口粘贴截图、选一个本地视觉模型，请求直接失败：

```
'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.
```

图片本身没问题，**标签**不对。

### 原因

`dsh-attachment-local` 归一化时按 alpha 通道选容器：

```js
const mediaType = hasAlpha ? "image/webp" : "image/jpeg";
```

截图带 alpha，于是被存成 WebP；请求图档（ladder）只有 `alpha:webp` 和
`opaque:jpeg` 两级，没有 PNG，也没有对应配置项。

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 再把 `version.mediaType` 直接写进 OpenAI 的 `image_url`：

```js
mimeType: version.mediaType,               // "image/webp"
data: Buffer.from(version.data).toString("base64"),
```

于是线上载荷变成 `data:image/webp;base64,...`。LM Studio / llama.cpp 只允许
PNG/JPEG 标签，整条请求被拒——而字节本身完全能解码。

### 做法

包装 `attachments.readImageRequest()`，**字节一个不改**，只换标签：

```js
return { ...version, mediaType: 'image/png' };
```

实测（`test/diagnostics/relabel-vs-transcode.py`，LM Studio）：

| 载荷 | 结果 |
|------|------|
| webp 字节 + `image/webp` | **HTTP 400** `'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.` |
| webp 字节 + `image/png`  | **HTTP 200**，图片被正确理解 |
| png 字节 + `image/png`   | HTTP 200 |
| png 字节 + `image/webp`  | **HTTP 400** |

即**只校验标签**，所以不需要真的转码。`test/diagnostics/vision-read.py` 进一步确认模型
是"真看见了"：让它读一张以 `image/png` 名义发出的 WebP 图上的字，能读对。

三个关键点都是核实过的，不是推测：

- **为什么不改请求消息？** 适配器的标签来自 `readImageRequest(...).mediaType`，
  不是消息块的 `ImageBlock.attachment.mediaType`，改消息没有任何作用。
- **为什么打补丁立刻生效？** 适配器每次请求都重新解析服务
  （`resolveAttachments: () => ctx.get("attachments")`），所以下一次请求就走新方法，
  不用重启、不用新会话。
- **为什么打在原型而不是实例上？** `ctx.get()` 返回 Cordis 的 "traceable" `Proxy`，
  实例级写入会被 shadow receiver 吞掉；原型属性一定会被 Proxy 的描述符查找命中。

模型可见的图片句柄文案不受影响：它取自 `ref.mediaType` 而不是 `version.mediaType`，
所以仍然准确描述存储的 WebP。

### 安装

本地目录（已实测）：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = link:/绝对路径/dsh-webp-relabel
```

手工安装则在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webp-relabel
      name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
```

### 配置（可选）

```yaml
- id: dsh-webp-relabel
  name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
  config:
    from: image/webp     # 被替换的标签
    to: image/png        # 替换成的标签
    debug: true          # 每张图打印一行日志
```

### 验证

`debug: true` 时 DSH 控制台会打印：

```
[dsh-webp-relabel] relabel #1: image/webp -> image/png

plugins.description: An eye-friendly green skin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-leafy-skin

An eye-friendly green skin: a leafy palette layered over the official DSH web GUI theme, in a
light emerald and a dark mint variant.

> I wanted the effect of a Minecraft resource pack.

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

## Compatibility

| Plugin version | DSH version |
| --- | --- |
| v0.1.1 | dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2 |
| v0.1.0 | dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2 |

## Screenshot

![Screenshot](show.png)

## Features

- **Layered greens** — a mist-green canvas, raised panels, and a deeper sidebar, with emerald
  accents in light mode and mint in dark, instead of one flat wash of green.
- **Comfortable by construction** — no pure white or pure black, a single green hue family, and
  all body text at WCAG AA (≥ 4.5:1).
- **Texture** — softer corner radii, green-tinted diffuse shadows, low-contrast hairlines, and
  glassy menu surfaces.
- **Details** — mint text selection, Inter / Noto Sans SC / Cascadia Code font stacks, slim
  scrollbars, and restrained hover and menu motion.
- **Tunable** — the palette is one commented table, a self-check script guards contrast, and the
  style layer has a single on/off switch.

## Install

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-leafy-skin
```

Restart DSH once afterwards so the profile recomposes. After that, colour edits only need a page
refresh (client changes hot-reload within about a second).

## Usage

Install the plugin and load the app. The skin layers itself over the active theme, so light, dark,
and follow-system each pick up their own variant automatically.

## Customize

- **Colours** — the `TOKENS` table in `lib/client.js`, grouped and commented by area.
- **Radii, shadows, fonts, motion** — the same file, plus the small style layer below it.
- **Palette only** — set `ENABLE_CSS_LAYER` to `false` in `lib/client.js` to drop the style layer
  entirely.
- **Check your work** — `node tools/check-palette.mjs` validates token shape, text and syntax
  contrast, and the style layer's three constraints.

## Uninstall

Any one of these, then restart DSH:

1. Comment out the `insert` entry in `cordis.patch.yml`;
2. Drop `dsh-leafy-skin` from `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`;
3. Run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-leafy-skin`.

## Known limitations

- The native window title bar belongs to the DSH desktop shell, not to this plugin, so it stays
  DSH grey for the instant before the page paints.
- Real see-through glass is impossible on Windows — the sidebar depth and translucent menus are
  colour layering, not blur through the window.
- Components hard-code font sizes and layout in hashed CSS modules, so this skin deliberately
  leaves them alone.

## Changelog

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

## Contributing

Questions and suggestions are welcome as issues. Pull requests are not accepted.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-show

A [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) client plugin for the Web UI: the composer's model
selector shows **Provider/Model** instead of a bare model name, so a selected model always names
the provider it comes from.

| | Composer trigger |
|---|---|
| Before | `Example Chat · High` |
| After  | `Example Provider/Example Chat · High` |

The dropdown menu is untouched: rows stay plain (`Example Chat`) under their provider
headings, and search keeps matching plain model names. The hover tooltip and ARIA label carry the
same `Provider/Model` text as the visible trigger.

![Composer trigger reading OpenCode Zen/DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Default](docs/composer-trigger.png)

A real trigger: provider `OpenCode Zen`, model `DeepSeek V4.1 Flash`; the trailing `Default` is the
thinking-effort suffix DSH already appends.

## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1 < 0.3.0-0`, `web` client platform (developed and tested against the Desktop
  runtime `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- The built-in model selection plugin (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`) must stay
  enabled. This plugin reuses its `modelDirectories` service and only shadows the composer seat.
- Provider names are whatever your own model configuration declares (`displayName` of each
  provider row), e.g. `Example Provider`, `Example Vendor`.

## Install

### Plugin market

Open the plugin market in the target DSH app, search for the package name `dsh-model-show`,
install it, then enable it.

### Desktop CLI

The Desktop app ships its own CLI (the reserved `desktop` profile is managed only by it):

```console
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-model-show
```

From GitHub, or from a local checkout:

```console
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:<user>/dsh-model-show
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\dsh-model-show"
```

Remove it with `plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-model-show`.

### From a DSH session

Ask the agent to install the bundle from this directory (`plugin_manager` with
`action: install_bundle` and the package directory as `target`).

Reload the page after installing. Replacing an already-loaded plugin with a different build needs
an application restart.

## Verify

1. The composer trigger reads `Provider/Model` (plus `· <effort>` when the model reports a
   reasoning effort).
2. Hovering it shows the same text.
3. The menu still lists plain model names under provider headings, and searching a provider name
   does not match models.

## How it works

- `lib/index.js` is the plugin's (empty) node half, so the bundle can be mounted by the profile's
  layer stack; the browser half is discovered through `dsh.client` + `exports["./client"]`.
- `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one row (`id: model-show`, `name: dsh-model-show`).
- `lib/client.js` is the built-in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` browser bundle with
  six documented edits (`scripts/vendor-from-asar.mjs`, each marked with an `EDIT:` comment in
  the generated file). The two that produce the visible change are the provider-prefixed
  `choices[].model.name` and registering the composer seat at `priority: -1`, which shadows the
  built-in seat because the lowest priority renders. The upstream `inject` list is left untouched
  (see Limitations — the seat resolves its catalog through the consuming context).
- The label is prefixed where the trigger reads it (`currentChoice?.model.name`), so the menu's own
  `groups` — and therefore search — stay untouched.

## Development

```console
npm test                 # offline checks: manifest, the six edits, and the label behaviour
npm run vendor           # re-extract the upstream bundle from the installed app and re-apply the edits
npm run vendor:check     # exit non-zero when the shipped bundle is not the vendored one
```

`npm run vendor` reads
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar` →
`dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection/lib/client.js`, or a client bundle
passed with `--from <client.js>` / an archive with `--asar <app.asar>`.

If upstream moves an anchor, vendoring fails loudly (`anchor not found (<label>) — upstream
bundle changed?`) instead of shipping a broken bundle; review the edits against the new bundle and
update the script, then re-run `npm test`.

Line endings are normalised to LF by `.gitattributes`. `lib/client.js` is compared byte for byte
against the vendored output, so a CRLF checkout would fail both `npm test` and `npm run vendor:check`.

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | Bundle and client manifest (`dsh.bundle.patch`, `dsh.client`) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin row into the profile layer stack |
| `lib/index.js` | Node half (empty `apply`, so the row can mount) |
| `lib/client.js` | Vendored browser bundle with the six edits |
| `scripts/vendor-from-asar.mjs` | Vendoring: extract from an installed DSH, apply and verify the edits |
| `tests/verify-bundle.test.mjs` | Offline verification of the shipped bundle |
| `icon.svg`, `locale/*.json` | Plugin Manager card metadata |
| `screenshots.json`, `docs/composer-trigger.png` | Storefront screenshot, declared in-repo so the market reads it from here |

## Limitations

- `lib/client.js` is a vendored copy of a built-in bundle, so it also requires
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, and
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store` from the browser module table (declared in
  `dsh.client.external`). A redesign of the built-in model selector in a future DSH release can
  break this bundle; `engines.dsh`, the vendoring script, and `npm test` are the guard rails.
- The plugin inherits the built-in control wholesale, including its stylesheet and its
  `min(360px, 45cqw)` trigger width; a long `Provider/Model` label is ellipsized rather than
  wrapped.
- The vendored bundle deliberately keeps the built-in plugin's whole service list (`commandUi`,
  `locale`, `sessions`, `slots`, `remote`, `remote.session`). The seat resolves its per-session
  catalog through the *consuming* context, so trimming the list to the services this plugin visibly
  uses throws `cannot get property "remote.session" without inject` on the first render after a
  launch; the slot registry then retires the crashing entry and the built-in seat renders instead —
  with no error shown anywhere. `npm run vendor` and `npm test` guard against that edit returning.
- No configuration: the format is fixed to `Provider/Model`.

## License

MIT. `lib/client.js` is derived from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` (MIT,
Copyright (c) DeepSeek). See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

plugins.description: Keeps the DeepSeek Harness context-usage ring honest: an empty usage sample during a retry no longer collapses it to 0%, and its percentage matches the figures beside it.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-usage-guard

Keeps the DeepSeek Harness composer's context-usage ring honest: an empty usage
sample during a retry no longer collapses it to `0%`, and its percentage is
typeset at the size of the figures beside it.
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/releases/tag/v0.2.0)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh)
plugin that repairs two defects in the composer's **context-usage ring** — one in
the value it shows, one in how large that value is drawn:

1. the ring stops dropping to `0%` while a model request is being retried — the
   host half; and
2. the ring's percentage renders at the size of every other figure on its own
   line — the browser half, one stylesheet rule.

## The two bugs it repairs

```
One line, in the composer footer:

  182 steps · 238 tok/s      33.4M tok · Cache hit 94%      ◯ 30%
                                                             ↑
              the ring's 30% was one pixel larger than every other figure

Mid-retry, the same ring read 0% instead of holding the last real reading:

  ◯ 0%   →   ◯ 6%
```

### The ring collapses to `0%` while a request is being retried

The ring renders the session projection `contextPressure`. That projection takes
the **newest usage sample** as the current prompt size and publishes:

```text
pressureTokens  = usage.inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens
projectedTokens = max(0, pressureTokens + surfaceTokens - sampledSurfaceTokens)
```

A model call that fails before the provider reports anything — a `429`, a rate
limit, a timeout, a transport error, or a user cancellation — still ends its
stream with a `usage` chunk:

```jsonc
[ { "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "usage",  "usage": { "inputTokens": 0, "outputTokens": 0, "totalTokens": 0 } } },
  { "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "finish", "reason": { "kind": "error",
      "failure": { "code": "RATE_LIMIT", "message": "429: token_capacity_exceeded" } } } } ]
```

The adapter's accumulator starts at zero and nothing ever overwrote it, so this
sample is *empty*, not a measurement. But it is the newest sample, so
`pressureTokens` becomes `0`, and because the sample is stamped at the current
surface total the projection publishes `projectedTokens: 0`. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry`
then retries the same step — six times in the session this plugin was written
from — and the ring reads `0%` for the whole storm, misreporting a context that
never changed.

Measured against the shipped `contextPressure` fold, replaying that session's
real events (`test/fold.spec.ts`):

| Replay | `pressureTokens` | `projectedTokens` | Ring |
|---|---|---|---|
| after the last successful call, before the retry | 64 389 | 64 389 | `6%` |
| the failed attempt, **unguarded** | 0 | 0 | `0%` ← the symptom |
| the failed attempt, **guarded** | 64 389 | 64 389 | `6%` |
| the retried step finally succeeds | 64 575 | 64 575 | `6%` |

### The percentage is one pixel larger than the figures beside it

The same footer band holds the session statistics and the ring, and the two
shipped stylesheets disagree by one pixel about how big a figure is:

```css
/* @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat — StatsPills.module.css, the pills */
.bOPqQW_root    { font-size: calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) - 1px) }

/* @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation — ContextMeter.module.css, the ring */
.JObwrW_trigger { font-size: var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) }
```

Both prefixes are content-hashed per build — the pair above is what the
`0.2.0-rc.2` packages installed here carry; the *declarations* are what matters,
and `test/meter-typography.spec.ts` re-reads them from the installed packages
rather than trusting this block.

So `30%` renders about 8% larger than the `182 steps`, `238 tok/s`, `33.4M tok`
and `Cache hit 94%` beside it, which reads as a different typeface. Measured on a
screenshot of that line: every other figure has a 12 px cap height, the ring's
has 13–14 px — a ratio of 1.08, exactly `13 ÷ 12`. The meter's own breakdown
panel is already `12px`, so the trigger is the outlier.

## What the plugin does

| Half | Surface | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `llm/stream` waterfall | one listener that withholds an empty usage sample belonging to a failed attempt, so the projection keeps its last real reading |
| Browser | the document `head` | one self-tagged stylesheet rule that puts the meter's percentage at the statistics pills' figure size |

Neither half adds a page, a route, a settings section or a stored file. The host
half declares `inject: ['llm']`, so the LLM service must exist first, and it
registers inside `ctx.effect`: cordis runs the disposer on unload, when the
profile patch disables the row, or at shutdown — a bare `ctx.on` would leak the
listener past unload.

One rule, applied to the chunk stream of every model call:

> A usage sample whose **every reported count is zero** measures nothing. When it
> belongs to an attempt that ended in `error` or `aborted`, it is dropped, so the
> previous real reading stands.

Everything else passes through untouched:

- **a successful completion**, whatever it reports — `stop`, `tool-calls` and
  `max-tokens` are authoritative provider answers, so a zero there is left for
  the consumer to judge;
- **a failed attempt that did report something** — a partial call can carry real
  input counts, so no billed counter is ever discarded;
- **stream shape, order and timing** — the withheld sample is the only chunk that
  moves; visible deltas keep their order and the terminal `finish` the retry
  executor reads is preserved.

## How the fix works

### Host half: the sample that decides the reading never lands

The wrapper holds **at most one** `usage` chunk and releases it immediately
before the next chunk, so the only chunk whose position can change is the sample
that decides the outcome. A stream that ends without its terminal `finish` still
releases a held sample — the guard never swallows information it did not
positively decide to drop. Withholding the chunk is legal in the stream protocol:
`usage` may appear at most once and is never required, `BlockAssembler.usage`
stays `undefined` without it, and the agent loop already omits the durable
event's `usage` field rather than failing. Token accounting is unaffected — the
projection's usage fold adds an empty sample's buckets as zero anyway, which
`test/fold.spec.ts` pins directly.

### Browser half: one stylesheet rule

The browser half adds one stylesheet rule that repeats the statistics
declaration verbatim:

```css
button[aria-haspopup="dialog"]:has(> svg > circle) {
  font-size: calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) - 1px);
}
```

- **Structural selector, not a class name.** The meter's button is the only
  dialog-opening control whose icon *is* the ring — an inline `<svg>` with
  `<circle>` children — while the statistics pills draw `<path>` icons. A build
  that re-hashes every class

plugins.description: Native DSH plugin for Tencent Hunyuan image generation. v1.0: two models (Hy-Image-3.5-preview up to 4K / 3.0), official resolution × aspect-ratio picker, batch 1/2/4, local gallery with search + regenerate, custom output folder, official advanced parameters, model-callable tool. Zero native deps; macOS/Windows/Linux. Docs in 8 languages.
plugins.readme_text:
# Tencent Hunyuan Image Generation · Native DSH Plugin

Languages: **English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md) · [Português](README.pt.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md)

> Bring Tencent Hunyuan's **Hy-Image-3.5-preview** and **Hy-Image-3.0** into
> [DSH (DeepSeek Harness)](https://deepseek.com) — with a generation panel, local gallery,
> the official two-step size picker and batch generation.
> **Zero native dependencies. Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux.**

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node: ≥20](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node-%E2%89%A520-green)](https://nodejs.org)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Windows%20%7C%20Linux-blue)](#)
[![CI](https://github.com/rayyugz/dsh-plugin-hunyuan-image/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](../../actions/workflows/ci.yml)

---

## ✨ Features

- **Two models**
  - `hy-image-v3.5-preview` — Chat/Messages protocol; multimodal input, multi-turn editing,
    chain-of-thought rewriting; up to **4K (4096×4096)** output
  - `hy-image-v3` — classic text-to-image; prompt rewriting and the official 37 preset sizes
- **Official two-step size picker** — **resolution tier × aspect ratio**, the same interaction as
  the Tencent TokenHub web console. The plugin converts your choice into the `WxH` string the API
  expects and guarantees it satisfies the official constraints
  (v3.5: edges in [256, 8192], area ≤ 16,777,216; v3.0: edges in [512, 2048], area ≤ 1,048,576).
  The UI shows the exact size that will be sent.
- **Batch generation** — generate **1 / 2 / 4 images** in one request (issued in parallel);
  results are shown one by one with a `1/4` index badge. Partial failures are reported explicitly.
- **Local gallery**
  - Every successful generation is **stored automatically** (plain-JS JSON storage — no SQLite, no native module)
  - **Thumbnail grid** and list views
  - **Keyword search** (matches the prompt and the rewritten prompt) plus filtering by model and time range
  - **Detail drawer** with the full prompt, model, size, timestamp and local path
  - **🔁 Generate again** — refills the original prompt and parameters in one click
  - Multi-select **batch delete** (also removes the local files), copy prompt, copy image
- **Customisable output folder** — defaults to `~/Pictures/DSH-Hunyuan-Image`, but you can point it
  anywhere (a non-system drive is recommended). Clicking **"Choose…"** opens the native OS folder picker.
  **Changes take effect immediately, no plugin restart needed.** Files are bucketed by month under
  `<folder>/<YYYY-MM>/` to avoid piling thousands of files into one directory.
- **Official advanced parameters** (session-scoped on purpose — see [Roadmap](#️-known-limitations--roadmap))

  | Parameter | Applies to | Description |
  |---|---|---|
  | Seed `seed` | both | Reproduce the same result |
  | Watermark footnote `footnote` | both | ≤ 16 characters, rendered in the bottom-right corner |
  | External search augmentation `use_search_tool` | v3.5 | Let the model search the web before drawing |
  | Reference-image area cap `resize_max_pixels` | v3.5 | Caps the token cost of large (4K/6K) reference images |
  | Automatic prompt rewriting `revise` | v3.0 | Adds ~11 s; recommended on by default |

- **Reference images** — upload from disk (converted to a data URL) or pass a public URL.
  v3.5 accepts up to 20 (≤ 20 MB each); v3.0 up to 3 (≤ 10 MB each).
- **Callable by the model** — the plugin registers a **`hunyuan_generate_image`** tool, so you can
  just say "draw a cat" in a conversation and the model will call it.
- **Durable images** — Tencent's remote URLs expire after **12 hours**; the plugin downloads every
  generated image to disk immediately, so gallery entries never break.

> 📌 Unimplemented features are listed honestly in
> [Known limitations & roadmap](#️-known-limitations--roadmap).
> This README only describes what the current version actually does.

---

## 📦 Installation

### Option 1 — Install from the Release (recommended, no build step)

1. Download `dsh-plugin-hunyuan-image-1.0.0.tgz` from the [**Releases**](../../releases) page.
2. Extract it into a permanent folder, e.g. `~/dsh-plugins/`:

   ```bash
   mkdir -p ~/dsh-plugins
   tar -xzf dsh-plugin-hunyuan-image-1.0.0.tgz -C ~/dsh-plugins
   ```

3. In the DSH chat, tell the assistant:

   > Please install `~/dsh-plugins/package` as a DSH plugin (use `plugin_manager` with `install_bundle`).

4. Restart DSH.

> Step-by-step reinstall / new-machine instructions: [**INSTALL.md**](INSTALL.md)
> (also available in [简体中文](INSTALL.zh-CN.md)).

### Option 2 — Build from source (developers)

Requires **Node ≥ 20** and **pnpm**.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/rayyugz/dsh-plugin-hunyuan-image.git
cd dsh-plugin-hunyuan-image

pnpm install
pnpm build                        # compile the host half + bundle the client half
node scripts/smoke-activate.mjs   # smoke test — should print "全部通过"

# Link into the DSH profile
# macOS / Linux:
ln -s "$(pwd)" ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-plugin-hunyuan-image
# Windows (PowerShell, administrator):
# New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-plugin-hunyuan-image" -Target "$PWD"
```

Then add the plugin name to the profile's `package.json` (in both `dependencies` and
`dsh.profile.bundles`) and restart DSH.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

### 1. Get an API Key

1. Sign up / log in at [Tencent Cloud](https://cloud.tencent.com)
2. Activate the [TokenHub service](https://console.cloud.tencent.com/tokenhub)
3. Create a Key on the [API Key page](https://console.cloud.tencent.com/tokenhub/apikey) — it looks like `sk-...`
4. Enable **pay-as-you-go** for `hy-image-v3.5-preview` and `hy-image-v3` under
   [Online inference → Vision models](https://console.cloud.tencent.com/tokenhub/inference?regionId=1&serviceType=VISION)

### 2. Fill in the plugin settings

Open the plugin panel (**🖼 Hunyuan Image** button under the composer) → **Settings** tab:

| Field | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| **API Key** | The Key created above | — |
| **Output folder** | Anywhere you like; a non-system drive is recommended | `~/Pictures/DSH-Hunyuan-Image` |
| **Default model** | `hy-image-v3.5-preview` or `hy-image-v3` | v3.5-preview |
| **Default resolution** | See [Sizes](#-sizes) | `1K` |
| **Default aspect ratio** | See [Sizes](#-sizes) | `1:1` |
| **Watermark footnote** | ≤ 16 characters, bottom-right corner | empty |

Click **Save**, then **🔌 Test connection** to verify the Key works.

> ⚠️ **Note**: images are stored under a **month sub-folder**, e.g.
> `AI-images/2026-10/1791629683045-xxxx.png` — not directly in the folder root.

---

## 🖼 Sizes

The plugin mirrors the official TokenHub picker: pick a **resolution tier** and an **aspect ratio**.

### Hy-Image-3.5-preview

| Tier | Aspect ratios | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `1K` / `1.5K` / `2K` | `21:9` `16:9` `4:3` `1:1` `2:3` `3:2` `3:4` `9:16` | Area ≈ 1M / 2.36M / 4.19M px |
| `4K` | same | Area ≤ 16,777,216 px; e.g. 16:9 → `5461x3072` |
| `Auto` | — | No `size` is sent; the model decides |

### Hy-Image-3.0

| Tier | Aspect ratios | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `720P` / `1K` | `1:1` `3:4` `4:3` `9:16` `16:9` `3:5` `5:3` | Must satisfy edges ∈ [512, 2048] and area ≤ 1,048,576 |
| `Auto` | — | The model picks from the official 37 presets |

**Rough size reference** (what actually gets sent):

```
v3.5  1K   16:9 = 1365x768      1:1 = 1024x1024
      2K   16:9 = 2731x1536     1:1 = 2048x2048
      4K   16:9 = 5461x3072     1:1 = 4096x4096
v3.0  720P 16:9 = 1280x720      1:1 = 960x960
      1K   16:9 = 1365x768      1:1 = 1024x1024
```

All 62 combinations are validated programmatically against the official constraints.

---

## 📚 Using the gallery

| Action | How |
|---|---|
| **Search** | Search box at the top (300 ms debounce; matches prompt / rewritten prompt / keywords) |
| **Filter** | By model, and by time range |
| **Multi-select** | Checkbox on the card, or via the hover overlay |
| **Batch delete** | Select items →

plugins.description: DSH 的 Gotify 通知插件
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gotify-notify

DSH 的 Gotify 通知插件：**每轮会话结束**时向你的 [Gotify](https://gotify.net/) 服务器推送一条通知，可在 DSH 的插件管理页里直接配置，无需手改配置文件。

## 功能

- 监听会话的 `turn/end` 事件，按「成功 / 其它结果」分别使用两套标题模板。
- 支持占位符：`{id}`（会话短 id）、`{title}`（会话标题，与侧边栏一致）、`{turn}`（轮次）、`{reason}`（结束原因的**中文标签**）、`{reasonRaw}`（结束原因的原始标识）、`{error}`（失败原因，仅在出错时有内容）、`{cwd}`（工作目录名）、`{time}`（本地时间）；未知占位符原样保留。
- **触发原因多选**（`notifyReasons`）：勾选哪些结束原因才推送 —— 成功、失败、被阻断、已中止、已中断、超出长度上限、分支继承；默认除「分支继承」外全选，一个都不勾等于关闭通知。
- **分档优先级**：成功（`priorityCompleted`，默认 3）与非成功（`priorityError`，默认 8）各一档，失败比成功更醒目。
- **最低轮次门槛**（`minTurn`，默认 0）：轮次低于该值不推送，快速小问答不打扰；轮次缺失时不拦截（宁可多推）。
- 默认跳过子 Agent 会话，可开关。
- **等待用户决定通知**（`notifyQuestion`，默认关）：模型调用 `ask_user_question`（选择框）或 `request_user_input`（输入框）等用户做决定时也推送一条，使用独立的标题/正文/优先级；同一问题按调用 id 去重，只推一次（默认值见下）。权限审批提示不走会话事件，不在覆盖范围内。
- 推送失败只写日志，绝不影响会话本身。
- 插件管理页提供「发送测试通知」按钮，配好之后可以先验证再启用。
- 口令存在 **DSH 凭据库**里（和模型设置页写 API Key 是同一个地方），配置文件里只留一个引用名（`passwordEnv`，默认 `GOTIFY_PASSWORD`），所以 `cordis.patch.yml` 里不含任何机密；用户名不是机密，仍放在设置里。详见下面的「凭据」一节。

## 安装

### 通过 dshmarket 安装

```text
市场 → 搜索 gotify → 安装 → 重启 DSH
```

安装后 DSH 会读取本包的 `dsh.bundle.patch`，把下面这条行插进 Loader 树（行内容由本包的 `cordis.patch.yml` 提供）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: gotify-notify
      name: dsh-gotify-notify
```

### 从本地目录安装（开发调试）

在 profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`）里：

```powershell
pnpm add file:C:\path\to\dsh-gotify-notify
```

然后在该 profile 的 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里补上 `dsh-gotify-notify`，重启 DSH。

### 从旧的手工挂载迁移

如果你之前是手工挂在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（形如 `name: './gotify-notify/index.js'` 的相对路径 insert 行），**必须先删掉那条旧行**再安装本包，否则同一条通知会推送两次：

1. 打开 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`，删掉 `id: gotify-notify` 且 `name` 指向相对路径的整条 insert 行。
2. 删除旧目录 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/gotify-notify/`。
3. 把原来的 `url` 等设置好在插件管理页里重新填一遍（面板保存会写回 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`）。
4. 重启 DSH。

## 配置

打开 **设置 → 插件 → 找到 `dsh-gotify-notify` → 配置**（插件管理页的行内配置卡）。

| 字段 | 说明 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | Gotify 服务器地址，必须以 `http://` 或 `https://` 开头 | `https://gotify.21zys.com` |
| `user` | Gotify 用户名（用于自动创建/复用名为 `DSH` 的应用并换取 token）；留空则读启动环境变量 `GOTIFY_USER` | 空 |
| `passwordEnv` | **口令的凭据引用名**：口令存在凭据库的哪个名字下（同时是环境变量名） | `GOTIFY_PASSWORD` |
| `token` | 直接指定应用 token，填了就不再需要账号密码 | 空 |
| `titleCompleted` | 正常结束时的通知标题模板 | `DSH 任务完成` |
| `titleOther` | 非正常结束时的标题模板 | `DSH 轮次结束（{reason}）` |
| `notifyQuestion` | 模型弹出选择框/输入框等你做决定时也通知 | 关 |
| `titleQuestion` | 等待决定时的标题模板 | `DSH 等待你的决定` |
| `questionMessage` | 等待决定时的正文模板 | 见下 |
| `message` | 通知正文模板 | 见下 |
| `notifyReasons` | 哪些结束原因才推送（多选） | 除 `forked` 外全部 |
| `priorityCompleted` | 成功时的优先级，0–10 的整数 | `3` |
| `priorityError` | 非成功时的优先级，0–10 的整数 | `8` |
| `priorityQuestion` | 等待决定时的优先级，0–10 的整数 | `8` |
| `minTurn` | 最低轮次门槛，低于该值不推送 | `0` |
| `includeSubagents` | 连子 Agent 的轮次结束也通知 | 关 |

两点使用说明：

- **`token` 在面板上没有控件**：它是留给「手写配置 / 脚本装机」的字段，只能改 `cordis.patch.yml`（或删掉它，改用账号 + 口令换 token）。面板不提供控件是为了避免界面上出现两条互相冲突的取 token 路径。
- **写入时机分两种**：`notifyReasons` 多选与 `notifyQuestion`、`includeSubagents` 两个开关是**勾选即写入**（立刻落盘）；文本与数字字段要点「保存」才写盘。卡片上的「发送测试通知」打的是**已保存**的配置，有未保存修改时会先提示保存。

### 凭据

口令**不写进配置文件**。插件管理页里的口令控件走
`ctx.remote.credentials.set(ref, value)` 把值写进 DSH 的凭据库
（`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`，与模型 API Key 同一个库），配置文件里只留下
`passwordEnv` 这个引用名。是否已配置由 `describe()` 回读判定 —— 值永不回传。

插件求值时按下面的顺序找口令，前一条拿到就用前一条：

1. 凭据域按 `passwordEnv`（默认 `GOTIFY_PASSWORD`）解析 —— 凭据库与启动环境都走这一条；
2. 凭据域缺席、拒绝解析、或未命中该引用时，直接读启动环境里与 `passwordEnv` 同名的变量。

凭据域是**软探测**的：profile 没组合凭据服务时插件照常工作，直接从启动环境读，
不会因为缺一个服务就起不来。

默认正文：

```text
会话 {title} 第 {turn} 轮已结束
结果：{reason}
目录：{cwd}
时间：{time}
```

等待用户决定时的默认正文（`questionMessage`）：

```text
会话 {title} 在等你做决定（第 {turn} 轮）
目录：{cwd}
时间：{time}
```

> **模板里的换行怎么写？** 设置面板是单行输入框，换行请写成两个字符 `\n`，插件会还原成真正的换行。

`{reason}` 输出中文标签，`{reasonRaw}` 输出 DSH 的原始标识：

| 原始标识 | `{reason}` |
| --- | --- |
| `completed` | 成功 |
| `error` | 失败 |
| `aborted` | 已中止 |
| `interrupted` | 已中断 |
| `blocked` | 被阻断 |
| `max-tokens` | 超出长度上限 |
| `forked` | 分支继承 |

`turn/end` 的原因集合在 DSH 里是**可扩展**的（`TurnEndReasonMap` 允许后端新增取值），未收录的标识会原样显示，不会编造中文。等待决定通知的 `{reason}` 固定渲染为「等待用户输入」（`{reasonRaw}` 为 `awaiting-input`），它不是 `turn/end` 的原因，也不参与 `notifyReasons` 勾选。

`{error}` 只在 `error` 结束时才有内容：它取自 DSH 的失败快照 `reason.error`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 的 LlmFailure，含非空的 `message` 与 `code`），优先用 `message`，消息为空时回落到 `code`；其余结束原因渲染成**空串**，所以像 `结果：{reason}\n{error}` 这样的正文在成功时是干净的，不会残留 `{error}` 字面量。

配置保存在当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中，由 DSH 的配置编辑器自动维护；本包的 `cordis.patch.yml` 不预置 `config:`，避免出现两份互相覆盖的配置。

## 行为细节

- 只处理 `turn/end` 与 `tool/call`（后者仅限 `ask_user_question` / `request_user_input` 两个工具名）；子 Agent 判定同时看 `header.origin === 'subagent'` 与 `header.parentSession`，对两类通知一视同仁。
- 等待决定通知按 `tool/call` 的 `callId` 在内存里去重：同一次提问超时转为 pending、用户稍后回答重开（`continued`）时不重推；去重表有上限（500 条），满了整表清空、进程重启也会清空，两种情况下同一次提问最多多推一次。`minTurn` 门槛同样作用于提问（提问发生时轮次还在进行中，`{turn}` 是「第几轮在问」）。
- 触发判定链：结束原因先查 `notifyReasons` 集合（手写进配置的未收录新取值照样能触发推送；面板只展示已知原因，但勾选写回时会**原样保留**配置里的未知取值，不会悄悄删掉），再过 `minTurn` 轮次门槛（轮次缺失或非整数时放行，宁可多推）；优先级按「成功 / 非成功」分档，未知取值偏异常档。
- token 只在内存里缓存，进程重启后重新换取；缓存**绑定服务器地址**，改了 `url` 会自动重新换取，推送遇到 `401/403` 也会清缓存重取一次（token 被吊销的场景）；直接填写的 `token` 无法重取，只会原样报错。
- 每个 HTTP 请求都有 10 秒超时：服务器「连得上但不回包」时不会让通知链路永久挂起；卡片上的「发送测试通知」另有 60 秒兜底（宿主路由最多串 3 次 Gotify 请求，各 10 秒），超时会提示「等待服务器响应超时」，不会让按钮永久停在「发送中…」。
- 推送是 fire-and-forget：失败时只在 DSH 日志里记一条 `推送失败：…`（网络层错误会附上 `ECONNREFUSED` 之类的错误码，日志里不含 token 与口令）。
- 「发送测试通知」由宿主侧路由 `/gotify-notify/test` 处理，围栏是「回环 socket + 回环 Host」：DSH 桌面壳转发页面请求时会删掉 `Origin` 与 `Sec-Fetch-Site`，所以不能靠浏览器同源标记判定，只能以回环连接本身为权威边界（带了 `Origin` 时仍要求与 `Host` 同权威，`Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site` 一律拒绝）。

## 开发

```powershell
# 宿主半自检：Config / url / 凭据 / 模板渲染
node selfcheck.mjs

# 浏览器半自检：字典键双向检查 / 槽位注册 / 注入面 / 表单投影 / 官方组件 props 契约 / 保存与非法草稿 / 开关与原因勾选的失败路径 / 凭据写入时序 / 测试通知的五种结局（未保存 / 成功 / 宿主报错 / 超时 / 网络错误）
node selfcheck-client.mjs

# 清单自检：package.json 字段、exports/files（含通配导出）、版本与 engines、bundle patch 形态、icon 与 locale
node selfcheck-manifest.mjs
```

自检脚本需要能解析 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`，在未安装本包的目录里跑时可临时建目录联接：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path node_modules\@deepseek-ai\schemastery `
  -Target "$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\schemastery"
```

## 发布（上架 dshmarket）

dshmarket 只允许安装 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 精选列表里的来源，因此上架需要两步：

1. **发布 npm 包**（市场优先使用经仓库验证的 npm 包，比 GitHub 源码安装更快更稳）：

   ```powershell
   npm publish
   ```

2. **向 awesome-dsh-plugin 仓库提 PR**，在插件列表里加一条，`url` 指向本包仓库、`npm` 指向包名（本包已配置 `publishConfig.access = public`）。

条目生效后，用户在 dshmarket 里搜索 `gotify` 即可一键安装。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把多台 SSH 服务器存成主机清单，agent 在会话里按主机名引用（命令执行 + 远端文件读写）；设置界面管理，支持密钥/密码登录，会话窗口「+」菜单可选主机。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ssh-hosts

[![test](https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）加一组 SSH 工具：**把若干台服务器存成一份主机清单，agent 在会话里用主机名引用它们** —— 执行命令、读文件、写文件、改文件、列目录。

- 凭据只存**怎么连**（host / user / identityFile / 跳板），不存密码、不存密钥内容；
- 认证、known_hosts、ssh-agent 全部交给系统 OpenSSH，插件不重新实现加密；
- 多机：同时配置 N 台，一次调用指定一台；会话里可以 `ssh_use` 设默认机；
- **图形界面管理**：在 `设置 → 插件 → dsh-ssh-hosts`（或设置侧栏「SSH 主机」）里新增/编辑/删除主机、测连通性、设默认机；界面写的就是那份 YAML，改完立即生效，不用重启；
- 与本地同名工具语义一致（`read` 的 offset/limit 是行号，`edit` 要求 oldString 唯一）。

## 装

### 方式零：直接从 GitHub

```bash
git clone https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-ssh-hosts      # 桌面版则在「设置 → 插件」里选这个目录
```

[Releases](https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts/releases) 里也有打包好的 `dsh-ssh-hosts-x.y.z.tgz`，适合离线安装或内网分发。

### 方式一：桌面 App / CLI 的插件安装（推荐）

```bash
# CLI：把本目录（或 npm pack 出的 tgz）装进某个 profile
dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/plugin-dev/ssh-hosts
```

装完 `dsh web --dump-config | grep -A2 ssh-hosts` 应该能看到：

```
# == dsh-ssh-hosts
- id: ssh-hosts
  name: dsh-ssh-hosts
```

桌面版也可以在 **设置 → 插件** 里安装同一个 tgz / 目录；本插件声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，安装后会自动作为一层 bundle 参与 profile 组装（`insert` 一行 `id: ssh-hosts`）。

> 桌面 App 自己的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 独占：`dsh plugin --profile desktop ...` 会被拒绝（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。要装进桌面 App，请从 App 内的插件界面装，或者按 App 写 package.json 的方式加 `link:`/依赖后由 App 重启加载 —— 别去手改它的 profile 状态。

### 方式二：手写 patch 行

不想用它自带的 bundle patch、或想在别人的 profile 里手动挂，就在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`（或 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`）里加：

```yaml
- insert:
  - id: 'ssh-hosts'
    name: 'dsh-ssh-hosts'      # 也可以写 file:///绝对路径/plugin-dev/ssh-hosts/lib/index.js
    config:
      defaultHost: web-01
```

`config` 全部字段都有默认值，只写需要覆盖的即可。

## 配置

主机清单有两条路，用的是**同一份数据**（`ssh-hosts.yaml`）：

- **图形界面（推荐）**：装好后打开 `设置 → 插件 → dsh-ssh-hosts`（或设置侧栏的「SSH 主机」），在那里新增/编辑/删除主机、测试连通性、设默认机。界面写的就是下面这个 YAML，写完立即重载，**不用重启**。
- **手工编辑**：直接改 YAML；改完在界面上点「重新读取」，或重启。

![设置里的 SSH 主机卡片（窄列 ~340px）](docs/settings-card.png)

*窄列下的样子：一台主机一个块，事实在上、操作在下，长路径自己断行。*

界面能做的事：

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 新增 / 编辑 / 删除 / 设默认 | 字段校验与服务端同一套规则：错了当场红框标出**并说明怎么改**，不用等一次 400 |
| 测试连接 | 结果就地显示在那台主机下面（成功给耗时与远端首行，失败给 exit code 与原因），不用去翻底部日志 |
| 删除二次确认 | 在块内确认，并说清会连带清掉什么（例如「已存密码也一并清除」），不可撤销 |
| 过滤 | 主机多了按名称 / 地址 / 标签 / 备注 / 认证方式过滤，并显示匹配台数 |
| 键盘 | `Enter` 保存、`Esc` 取消；错误是 `role="alert"`、日志是 `aria-live`，读屏能听到 |
| 密码 | 只写不读：显示「已保存（来自哪一层）」或「未设置」，输入可显示/隐藏，清除要再确认一次 |
| 空状态 | 没有主机时直接给「新增主机」按钮 + 手工编辑提示，不用猜下一步做什么 |

### 1. 主机清单（界面与手工共用的那份文件）

```bash
cp ssh-hosts.example.yaml ~/.dsh/ssh-hosts.yaml
chmod 600 ~/.dsh/ssh-hosts.yaml     # 权限不是 0600 会被拒绝加载
$EDITOR ~/.dsh/ssh-hosts.yaml
```

文件**不存在**时插件照常启动、界面照常打开，只是清单为空：在界面上新增第一台主机就会把文件建出来（0600）。文件存在但坏掉（YAML 语法错、`hosts` 不是数组、权限过宽）仍然是**装载期硬失败** —— 那是真配置错误，越早炸越好。

```yaml
version: 1

hosts:
  - name: web-01                    # ← agent 在会话里引用的名字
    host: 10.0.0.11
    user: deploy
    identityFile: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 # 密钥登录；必须 0600。省略 = 交给 ssh-agent/默认密钥
    defaultWorkdir: /srv/app
    description: 生产 Web（Nginx）
    tags: [prod, web]
    port: 22
    proxyJump: bastion              # 本清单里的 name，或 user@host:port
    connectTimeoutSec: 15
    keepAliveSec: 30
    readOnly: true                  # 拒绝 ssh_write / ssh_edit

  - name: db-01
    host: 10.0.0.12
    user: root
    passwordRef: DSH_SSH_HOSTS_PASSWORD_DB_01   # 密码登录：只写「凭据名」，不写密码
    tags: [prod, db]
```

字段全部可选（`name` / `host` 必填），**未知字段会直接报错**，拼错不会被静默忽略。清单里写 `password:` / `passphrase:` 会被专门拒绝，并告诉你该怎么放密码。

### 1.1 登录方式：密钥 / 密码 / ssh-agent

| 方式 | 清单里怎么写 | 怎么设置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **密钥**（推荐） | `identityFile: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` | 界面「登录方式 → 密钥文件」，填路径即可（文件必须存在且 0600） |
| **密码** | `passwordRef: DSH_SSH_HOSTS_PASSWORD_XXX` | 界面「登录方式 → 密码」，在密码框里填一次；插件把值交给 DSH 凭据库，清单里只留引用名 |
| **密钥优先、密码兜底** | 两个字段都给 | 界面选「密钥优先，密码兜底」 |
| **ssh-agent / 默认密钥** | 两个字段都不给 | 界面选「ssh-agent / 默认密钥」，交给 OpenSSH 自己挑 |

密码**不进清单文件**：`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（0600，DSH 自己的凭据库）存值，`ssh-hosts.yaml` 只存名字。所以清单可以安全地备份/分享；界面、HTTP 响应、模型可见的工具输出里都**只回报「有没有、来自哪一层」**，永远不回显密码。删主机或点「清除已存密码」会顺手把凭据库里的那条删掉，不留孤儿。

密码登录的实现是 OpenSSH 官方路子（`SSH_ASKPASS` + 一次性 0600 文件）：密码不进命令行参数、不进环境变量、不进日志，`ps` 里看不到；每次调用前现解析、用完即删，所以改完密码**下一次调用就生效**，不用重启。没有凭据服务的 profile（极少见）插件照常工作，只是密码主机连不上，界面会说明原因。

### 2. 图形界面背后的 HTTP 路由

界面（浏览器半边）通过同源路由读写清单，也**可以只用 curl**（同一个 web server，CSRF/Host 校验与其它 GUI 接口一致）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/ssh-hosts/hosts` | 清单 + 文件信息 + 是否可写 + 默认机 |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/hosts` | 新增/修改一台（`{ host: {...}, previousName?, password?, clearPassword? }`，改名靠 `previousName`；`password` 只进不出，`clearPassword: true` 清除） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/hosts/delete` | 删除（`{ name }`） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/default` | 设/清默认机（`{ name }`，空串清除） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/reload` | 重新读盘（手工改完文件点这个） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/test` | 真实 SSH 连上去跑一条只读命令 |

返回统一是 `{ ok: true, value }` 或 `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`；`400` 参数/文件内容有误、`409` 清单来自 config 不可写、`404` 主机不存在、`501` 当前 profile 没有凭据服务（存不了密码）、`403/401` 未过 Host/来源/登录校验。写入顺序是**先校验、再原子写、再重载**，重载失败会把文件回滚成写之前的字节 —— 界面上一次误操作不会让正在跑的会话失去目标机。

### 3. 插件 config

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hostsFile` | `$DSH_HOME/ssh-hosts.yaml` | 清单路径；相对路径按 `$DSH_HOME` 解析 |
| `defaultHost` | 空 | 没指定 host、本会话也没 `ssh_use` 过时用的默认机 |
| `knownHostsFile` | 空（OpenSSH 默认） | 自定义 known_hosts 路径 |
| `strictHostKeyChecking` | `accept-new` | `accept-new` / `yes` / `no` |
| `connectTimeoutSec` | 10 | 建连超时 |
| `timeoutMs` | 60000 | 单条命令默认超时 |
| `maxOutputBytes` | 262144 | stdout/stderr 各自保留上限（超出保尾并标记截断） |
| `maxReadBytes` | 8388608 | 单文件读取上限 |
| `controlPersistSec` | 300 | 连接复用时长；0 = 每次重建连 |
| `allow` / `deny` | `[]` | `ssh_run` 命令正则白/黑名单（deny 优先） |
| `hosts` | `[]` | 就地声明主机（非空时忽略 `hostsFile`） |

这些标量字段都是 DSH 的 **volatile** 字段：在设置页改完**不用重启插件**，下一次工具调用就用新值（插件每次读配置都解包 volatile 引用）。`hosts` 例外 —— 它是部署方声明，改了要重启；而且它非空时界面变成只读，避免「设置页改一半、YAML 改一半」。

## 用：添加完主机，怎么引用

**在会话窗口里直接选**（新增，最快）：点输入框左边的 **「+」**，在命令菜单里选 **`ssh`** → 弹出主机列表（带 `user@host`、标签、认证方式，并标出本会话当前在用哪台）→ 点一台即可。它设的是**本会话**默认主机（和 `ssh_use` 同一条路径、同一份状态），之后你在这个会话里说「执行 uname -a」就直接落到那台机器。也可以手打 `/ssh <主机名>`，`/ssh clear` 清除。

> 一个平台规则：输入框里**已经有内容**时，「+」菜单只列不带参数的命令（`ssh` 带参数提示，所以那时不显示）—— 这是 DSH 对斜杠菜单的统一约定，`/permission` 等命令同样如此。想在已有草稿上换机器，先选中草稿前的空白再点「+」，或直接手打 `/ssh <主机名>`。

**在会话里直接说人话也行**（最常用）：

```
在 web-01 上执行 systemctl status nginx
看一下 db-01 的 /etc/mysql/my.cnf
把 web-01 的 /srv/app/.env 里 PORT=8080 改成 PORT=9090
```

agent 会先 `ssh_hosts()` 看清单，再带上 `host: "web-01"` 调用对应工具。主机名就是你在界面里填的「名称」。

**显式调用**（想知道底层发生了什么时）：

```
ssh_hosts()                                        → 列主机（含 auth 方式、tags、默认目录）
ssh_use({ host: "web-01" })                        → 设为本会话默认机，之后可以省略 host
ssh_run({ command: "uname -a" })                   → 在默认机上跑
ssh_run({ host: "db-01", command: "df -h" })       → 指定机器跑（不依赖默认机）
ssh_read({ host: "web-01", path: "/etc/nginx/nginx.conf", offset: 1, limit: 40 })
ssh_write({ host: "web-01", path: "/tmp/hello.txt", content: "hi\n" })
ssh_edit({ host: "web-01", path: "/srv/app/.env", oldString: "PORT=8080", newString: "PORT=9090" })
ssh_ls({ host: "web-01", path: "/srv/app" })
```

主机解析优先级：**显式 `host` 参数 → 本会话 `ssh_use` → 界面设的默认机 → `config.defaultHost` → 报错并列出可用主机**（绝不再猜一台）。界面上点「设为默认」写的就是第三档；默认机是**全局**的，`ssh_use` 是**本会话**的。

模型看到的 7 个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `ssh_hosts` | 列出可用主机（含 tags / 说明 / 默认目录 / 认证方式），可按 tag 过滤；`defaultHost` + `defaultSource` 告诉你本次调用实际会用哪台 |
| `ssh_use` | 读/设本会话默认主机，之后其它工具可省略 `host` |
| `ssh_run` | 执行命令，返回 exitCode / stdout / stderr（**非零退出是正常结果**） |
| `ssh_read` | 读文本文件，可给行号区间 |
| `ssh_write` | 整文件写入（远端临时文件 + rename 原子替换，保留原权限） |
| `ssh_edit` | 精确字符串替换（要求唯一匹配，除非 `replaceAll`） |
| `ssh_ls` | 列目录（类型/权限/大小/时间） |

主机解析优先级：**显式 `host` 参数 → 本会话 `ssh_use` → 界面设的默认机 → `config.defaultHost` → 报错并列出可用主机**（绝不再猜一台）。

三种方式的作用域要分清：**会话窗口的「+ → ssh」和 `ssh_use` 是「本会话」**（互不干扰，换会话就没了）；**设置页的「设为默认」是全局**（所有没有会话默认的会话都用它）。`ssh_hosts` 报的 `defaultHost` 是**本次调用实际会用的那台**（会话默认 → 全局默认 → `config.defaultHost`），`defaultSource` 告诉你是哪一档。

`readOnly: true` 的主机会拒绝 `ssh_write` / `ssh_edit`（
